Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/x509/x509_provider.h"
Description:
X.509 Provider interface.
Notes:
The X.509 Provider supports two internal storages: volatile (or session) and persistent.
All X.509 objects created by the provider should have an actual reference to their parent X.509
Provider.
The X.509 Provider can be destroyed only after destroying of all its daughterly objects.
Each method of this interface that creates a X.509 object is non-constant, because any such
creation increases a references counter of the X.509 Provider.
Any user of this interface should create shared pointers to it only by calls of the method
shared_from_this()!
